results.name: CLI help
results.stdout:
Traffic Management System (Simulation)
Usage: traffic_sim --scenario <file> [--show-scenario] [--lane-status] [--trace] [--report <output.csv>]
       traffic_sim --validate <file>
       traffic_sim --help
--show-scenario prints the configured network and traffic without running it.
--trace prints the scenario overview, then each tick's signals, vehicle movement, waits and deferrals.
--report exports simulation performance metrics as CSV.
